name: The Relay
description: Keep roads and lifts open. Help Iri deliver food and medicine, fix crossings, and stop toll collectors. Decide how to share roads when companies also want to use them.

name: Glass Covenant
description: Protect people’s memories and privacy. Help Sera stop unauthorized copies and check who gave permission. Decide how to share the water needed to keep memories safely stored.

name: Ash Foundry
description: Protect workers and keep homes warm. Help Bram repair machinery, make shifts safer, and end inherited work debts. Decide how to share limited fuel and heat.

name: Null Choir
motto: Let people choose what they hear.
description: Let people choose what they hear while keeping useful warnings. Help Ves stop forced broadcasts and build alarms people can see or feel. Decide when an emergency justifies an interruption.
